> 第1章 助我重生（第1页）
一个少女跌跌撞撞往前冲，后面有几个家奴模样的人紧追不舍。
“世子可等着呢，可别让她跑了！”
少女身体虚软，额上还有一个红肿的大包，眼前开始模糊，但她知道绝对不能让对方抓住。
她在乡下住了十来年，好不容易被接回京，家门都还没进，就被从马车里扯了下来，打了一闷棍塞进了花轿。
被打的眩晕缓过来之后，她不顾一切从轿里跳了出来，慌不择路狂奔。
后面一家奴听她大喊，恼怒地骂了一句粗话，抄起路边一块石头就朝她猛地砸了过来。
石头划破风声，狠狠地砸中了她的后脑勺。
剧痛传来，少女眼前一黑，身体往前扑倒，她凭着最后一分清醒，连扑带爬地滚出了巷子。
就在这时，一辆马车正好经过这个巷子口。
少女这么一扑出来，直接就滚撞到了马车前面。
突来的变故，也让周围百姓惊呼出声。
那几个家奴急追出来，没看清楚眼前情况，见少女伏在马车前面，立即就要上前抓人。
趁没人看清楚这姑娘的样子，赶紧把她弄回去！
少女被一人抓住肩膀，濒死一瞬间爆发出最后力气，猛地挣脱开他，转身爬上了马车，一头栽进了马车里，撞进一人胸膛。
车夫一鞭甩开了家奴，瞳孔一缩。完蛋了，这当隙竟然让那姑娘钻进了车厢？
马车里，一只骨节分明修长的手，掐住了少女的脖子，将她推离自己怀抱。
正要将这具尸体抛出马车，那被掐着脖子的少女却“刷”地睁开了眼睛。
刹那间，眸光冷洌，带着寒霜般的杀意。
死而复生的陆昭菱一睁开眼睛，便看到了一张摄心夺魄的脸。
墨发紫玉冠，衬得肤似雪，淡墨轻染一样的长眉，如星子落深海一样的眸，鼻直如峰，唇就像最优美的花瓣，但唇角微带冷意，平添几分危险意味。
下一秒，陆昭菱倏地出手，袭向了他的咽喉。
指尖如剑，凌厉得像要直接插进他的喉咙。惊艳的气氛瞬息变为杀机汹涌。
脖子掐着的手蓦地用力一捏，同时，对方另一只手抓住了陆昭菱的手腕。
陆昭菱头痛欲裂，感觉到后脑勺有血流着，听着他低沉的声音，抬眸看着他一身紫气，以及那股正一点点蚕食紫气的黑雾。
原来是他的帝星紫气，助她生而复生，从这个小姑娘身上活了过来。
感觉着脖子越掐越紧，陆昭菱指向他的胸膛，艰难地挤出一句话。
那只骨节分明的手微一顿，又把她拽到眼前，两人离得很近，陆昭菱闻到了他身上一丝清冽气味。
两人目光近距离碰撞，似乎有火花啪啪炸响。

> Chapter 1 Help me to be reborn (Page 1)
A young girl stumbled forward, followed by several people who looked like domestic slaves chasing after her.
"The prince is waiting, don't let her run away!"
The girl's body was weak, and there was a big red and swollen bump on her forehead. Her vision began to blur, but she knew she must not let the other party catch her.
She had lived in the countryside for more than ten years, and was finally brought back to Beijing. Before she even entered the house, she was pulled out of the carriage, beaten and stuffed into a sedan chair.
After the dizziness from the beating subsided, she jumped out of the sedan regardless of the situation and ran in panic.
The slave in the back heard her shouting, cursed angrily, picked up a stone from the roadside, and threw it at her.
The stone cut through the wind and hit her hard on the back of the head.
Severe pain was felt, and the girl's vision went dark, and her body fell forward. With her last bit of consciousness, she rolled out of the alley, crawling on the ground.
At this moment, a carriage happened to pass by the entrance of the alley.
As soon as the girl jumped out like this, she rolled directly into the front of the carriage.
The sudden change also caused the people around to scream in surprise.
The servants chased her out in a hurry. They didn't see the situation clearly. When they saw the girl crouching in front of the carriage, they immediately stepped forward to arrest her.
Get this girl back quickly before anyone can see her clearly!
The girl was grabbed by someone's shoulders. She burst out of her last strength at the moment of death, broke away from him, turned around and climbed into the carriage, fell headlong into the carriage, and bumped into someone's chest.
The coachman whipped the slave away and his pupils shrank. It's over. At this moment, the girl actually got into the carriage?
In the carriage, a slender hand with distinct joints grabbed the girl's neck and pushed her away from his arms.
Just as he was about to throw the body out of the carriage, the girl who was strangled opened her eyes.
In an instant, his eyes were cold and filled with killing intent like frost.
As soon as Lu Zhaoling, who was resurrected from the dead, opened his eyes, he saw a heart-rending face.
Her dark hair and purple jade crown make her skin look like snow, her long eyebrows are lightly dyed with light ink, her eyes are like stars falling into the deep sea, her nose is as straight as a peak, and her lips are like the most graceful petals, but there is a slight coldness at the corners of her lips, adding a hint of danger.
The next second, Lu Zhaoling suddenly struck at his throat.
The fingertips were like swords, so sharp that they seemed to be thrust directly into his throat. The stunning atmosphere instantly turned into a murderous atmosphere.
The hand holding his neck suddenly squeezed hard, and at the same time, the opponent's other hand grabbed Lu Zhaoling's wrist.
Lu Zhaoling had a splitting headache and felt blood flowing on the back of his head. Listening to his deep voice, he raised his eyes and looked at the purple energy all over him and the black mist that was eating away at the purple energy bit by bit.
It turned out that it was his Imperial Star Purple Qi that helped her come back to life, and the little girl came back to life.
Feeling her neck getting tighter and tighter, Lu Zhaoling pointed to his chest and struggled to squeeze out a sentence.
The sharp-jointed hand paused for a moment before pulling her to his eyes. The two of them were so close that Lu Zhaoling could smell a hint of the fresh scent on him.
The two people's eyes collided at close range, and sparks seemed to explode.
